name: Deploy Main to Staging Manually
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4
      - name: Configure AWS credentials
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v6
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::285938427530:role/wca-on-rails-github-deploy-staging
          aws-region: ${{ secrets.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION }}
      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        id: login-ecr
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2
      - name: Get the SHA of the current branch/fork
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "SHORT_SHA=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Build staging images
        uses: ./.github/actions/build-environment
        with:
          environment: staging
          build_tag: ${{ env.SHORT_SHA }}
          registry: ${{ steps.login-ecr.outputs.registry }}/wca-on-rails
      - name: Deploy staging
        run: |
          aws ecs update-service --cluster wca-on-rails --service wca-on-rails-staging --force-new-deployment
          aws ecs update-service --cluster wca-on-rails --service wca-on-rails-staging-sqs-worker --force-new-deployment
          aws ecs update-service --cluster wca-on-rails --service wca-on-rails-staging-API --force-new-deployment

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
